=> < UserX | 'near' : DeviceX , 'key' : nils , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : DeviceX , ... > $ UserX 'leave' DeviceX
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < DeviceX | 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' DeviceX
=> < DeviceX | 'key' : Key , ... > $ DeviceX 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) .
[B3] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > $ DeviceX 'sendKey' UserX | (Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > .
[B4] < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < DeviceX | ... > < CloudX | DeviceX : ('key' : Key , 'owner' : nils , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'bind' CloudX | (DeviceX ; Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < DeviceX | ... > < CloudX | DeviceX : ('key' : Key , 'owner' : UserX , ...) , ... > .
